proposal.impact_reason: The exact committed Feature revision specifies immutable candidate, validation material, receipt and accepted merge identities; a shared matcher; and drift, failure and restart contracts in work records only. It changes no product source, DESIGN.md, model, views or source contract. The current package design and integrated Teams Code view describe the existing validator, profile, reservation, board scan and publication owners and explicitly limit source-only checks. Task 1 owns isolated candidate and runner changes, Task 2 owns exact receipt admission and publication, and Task 3 owns accepted merge identity and final design/C4 reconciliation. Task 1 primary acceptance remains TBD while active; its detailed acceptance and Feature-owned contract carry the requirements pending supported lifecycle reconciliation. This review does not claim planned behavior is implemented. Reviewed design paths, 14 passing source-contract tests, impact inventory and delivery gates are recorded in docs/feature_artifacts/feat_054_001_architecture_planning_review.md.
